structure.description: The full movie ratings join to movie metadata through movie_links: ratings.movieId to links.movieId, then links.tmdbId to metadata.id.
The small ratings subset has its own matching links_small table and uses the same two-stage identifier mapping.
Credits and keywords join directly to movie_metadata on the TMDB id field.
top2017.csv and top2018.csv are year partitions with identical columns; spotify_tracks and top50_2020 use related but not identical Spotify schemas.
Movie, book, Netflix, Spotify, and video-game objects are independent collections without a declared shared identifier.

uncertainties: Nested movie fields are text representations of Python-like objects and may include malformed or missing entries.
Zero budget or revenue can mean unknown rather than a true zero.
Identifier columns that look numeric should be preserved as identifiers to avoid formatting loss.
annotation_notes: Annotation was derived from public file names, source headers, encodings, and representative records only.
